inventory.answer: near the junction of six roadways in the center of Bristol, just north of the Newfound River and west of the Pemigewasset River

decision.explanation: The question asks for the location of the Central Square Historic District. Two distinct districts share the same name but are located in different towns: Bristol, New Hampshire (D1S1), and Stoneham, Massachusetts (D2S1). Both are valid referents and should be preserved as separate answers. Candidate C2 provides a more detailed description of the Bristol district’s location but does not resolve the ambiguity between the two distinct districts and is better treated as supplementary rather than primary.
